position.label: Filter tree style
position.info: First-paint default only. Findly app Settings → Filter panel overrides this after load.

position.label: Filter tree style
position.info: First-paint default only. Findly app Settings → Filter panel overrides this after load.

product_grid_selector.label: Product grid selector
product_grid_selector.info: CSS selector for the collection product list (e.g. #product-grid). Leave blank to auto-detect.

use_quickview_template.label: Use custom quickview template
use_quickview_template.info: Adds a Quick view button on product cards. Uses [data-findly-quickview] from the product template when present.

custom_javascript.label: Custom javascript
custom_javascript.info: Runs on the storefront after Findly loads. Merchant-owned code.

custom_css.label: Custom css
custom_css.info: Add custom styles to Filter and the app product grid.

product_template.label: Load Custom Product Template
product_template.info: HTML for each product card. Placeholders: {{product.title}}, {{product.url}}, {{product.image}}, {{product.price}}, {{product.vendor}}, {{product.handle}}, {{product.id}}, {{product.available}}. When filled, Findly renders this instead of hiding/showing theme cards.

tree_template.label: Load Custom Tree Template
tree_template.info: Optional HTML wrapper for the filter panel. Include an element with data-facets. Placeholders: {{title}}.

sort_template.label: Load Custom Sort Template
sort_template.info: Optional HTML for the sort control. Must include a select with data-sort.

search_template.label: Load Custom Search Template
search_template.info: Optional HTML for in-collection search. Must include an input with data-collection-search.

variables.label: Variables
variables.info: Liquid rendered into the embed config (e.g. {{ theme.id }}). Available in templates as {{variables}}.
